purpose: Read-only feasibility check: dedicated VA entry topic invoking SCC agent through AI Connector, preserving mid-execution user questions and explicit confirmation.
outcome: NOT PROVEN. Available primary documentation and captured source do not establish interactive handoff for AI Connector -> AI Agent. They also do not establish that this connector is noninteractive-only.
decision: Do not implement a three-node entry topic based on the current evidence.
missing_contract: Which execution_mode the AI Connector invocation selects
Whether the caller's VA conversation identity is propagated to the execution plan
Whether intermediate user-input controls are delivered to the calling conversation
Whether user responses resume the same AI-agent execution plan while preserving confirmation requirements

sources.finding: Documents Task input and output mappings returned after task completion. Does not state whether intermediate questions or confirmations are routed back to the calling VA conversation.
Wait for response delays continuation of the topic. This does not prove interactive handoff during the agent invocation.
Documents Interactive and Non Interactive execution modes selected by runtime parameter in sn_aia_execution_plan. Does not tie a mode to the AI Connector invocation.

PRB1934841 concerns a null conversation field when invoking an AI agent from an AI connector node. This shows a relevant defect area; it does not prove interactive support, current instance applicability, or resolution status.

offline_inspection.finding: No captured AI Connector implementation or invocation contract found. Existing AI Connector references were the prior routing evidence summary.

ui_inspection.runtime_utility_lookup: Attempted documented AiAgentRunttimeUtil through ordinary list search; list interpreted unprefixed search as name>= and did not identify the utility. No runtime or connector implementation was established.
ui_inspection.limitation: One navigation click had a protocol timeout. No record field edits, saves, script execution, API calls, or topic creation occurred. Further UI research stopped on root instruction.

cautions: Do not infer connector interactivity from generic AI-agent Interactive mode support.
Do not infer connector interactivity from supervised Flow Designer mode.
Do not infer noninteractive-only behavior from after-completion output mapping documentation.
Do not replace sys_cs_topic identifiers with sn_aia_agent identifiers.
